senses.gloss: (v. צוֹאָה) to soil. Part. pass. צָאוּי dirty, unwashed (wool).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 10:5">Tosef. Ḥull. X, 5</cite> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="R00186"><he>צוֹי</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="R00150"><he>צוֹאִי</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to treat as excrement. Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ (ref. to צֵא, Is. XXX, 22, v. LXX) צָאיהוּ נבלהו, v. נָבֵל; Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵃ bot. צָאֵהוּ.
